entities.summary: Alessandro Alunni Bravi is an Italian lawyer and manager, best known for being Chief Business Affairs Officer of the McLaren Driver Development Programme since 2025. Throughout his motorsports career, Alunni Bravi held the position of Team Principal and Managing Director of Trident Racing and General Counsel of ART Grand Prix and Spark Racing Technology, amongst other ventures, as well as acted as legal counsel for over twenty years.
